in_sanskrit.name: सिलु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Silu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sil' meaning 'slender, slim, or graceful'. It is a feminine name and is often used to describe a beautiful and elegant woman.

in_hindi.name: सिलू
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Silu in Hindi is the same as in Sanskrit. It is a feminine name and is used to describe a beautiful and graceful woman.

in_tamil.name: சிலு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The meaning of Silu in Tamil is unclear as it is not a commonly used name in Tamil literature or texts. However, it is possible that it could be derived from the Tamil word 'cil' meaning 'needle', in which case the name could mean 'Slender as a Needle'.

in_telugu.name: శిలు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Silu in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sil' meaning 'slender, slim'. It is a feminine name and is used to describe a beautiful and elegant woman.

in_marathi.name: Silu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain or peak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Silu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Silu means 'Mountain or peak' in Sanskrit and Tamil.
